items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: to me Billy Strayhorn was one of the most underrated musicians that I've ever known.

ctx.x: Thought I heard that. How about Billy Strayhorn?

Well I'm not sure whether I told you before, but to me Billy Strayhorn was one of the most underrated musicians that I've ever known. He was a real, real musician. A musician to me is a person who gets his material through the influence from say, you take a trip and you look at the mountains or you go across a certain bridge and you get the feeling of beauty and you interpret it and it's musically -- or those kind of things and they put them down in music. To me that is the real musician. That was the real…
way back then and until today no one has ever played "Lush-life" in the exact way that Strayhorn wanted it to be played.
